title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 63
paragraphs: The Assyrians served with bronze helmets on their heads, or with helmets plaited in a barbarian style not easily described; they carried shields and spears, and daggers like the Egyptian knives, and also wooden clubs studded with iron knobs, and linen corselets. These are called Syrians by the Greeks, but by the barbarians they have always been called Assyrians; among them were also the Chaldeans. Their commander was Otaspes son of Artachaees.
